parameters.subject: =Your 30-Day Onboarding Schedule, {{ $json.Name }}
=Welcome to the Team {{ $('Parse Schedule1').item.json.Name }}, Here Is Everything You Need for Day One
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $('Parse Schedule1').item.json.Name }},

We are absolutely thrilled to welcome you to the team as our new {{ $('Parse Schedule1').item.json.Role }} in the {{ $('Parse Schedule1').item.json.Department }} department.

Your first day is {{ $('Parse Schedule1').item.json['Start Date'] }}, and we want to make sure you arrive feeling confident, prepared, and excited about what is ahead.

HERE IS WHAT TO EXPECT ON DAY ONE:

Your manager, {{ $('Parse Schedule1').item.json['Manager Name'] }}, will be your first point of contact and will reach out to you directly before your start date to introduce themselves and share any additional details about your first day.

WHAT TO BRING:
A valid means of identification for HR documentation and your personal laptop if you have one, though one will be provided if needed.

YOUR FIRST WEEK OVERVIEW:
Your first week is designed to help you settle in, meet your team, understand how we work, and start contributing in a way that feels comfortable and supported. A detailed 30-day onboarding task schedule will be sent to you in a separate email shortly so you know exactly what to expect and when.

KEY CONTACTS:
Your Manager: {{ $('Parse Schedule1').item.json['Manager Name'] }}
HR Contact: hr@company.com
General Support: support@company.com

We have already set up your workspace, notified your team, and prepared everything you need to hit the ground running.

Once again, welcome to the team. We are glad you are here, and we cannot wait to see what we will build together.

Warm regards,
Joshua T. Ikotun
Human Resources

options.systemMessage:
You are an employee onboarding specialist responsible 
for generating structured 30-day onboarding task 
schedules for new hires.

Your job is to create a personalized, realistic, and 
actionable onboarding plan that helps a new employee 
integrate into their role and team effectively within 
their first 30 days.

You will receive the following information:
- Employee Name
- Role
- Department
- Start Date
- Manager Name

Onboarding Philosophy:
- Week 1 focuses on orientation, introductions, 
  and understanding the company and team
- Week 2 focuses on tools, processes, and 
  role-specific training
- Week 3 focuses on taking ownership of small 
  tasks and contributing independently
- Week 4 focuses on full integration, goal setting, 
  and preparing for the first performance check-in

Structure Rules:
- Divide the schedule into 4 weeks
- Provide 5 tasks per week, one per working day
- Each task must be specific to the employee's 
  role and department
- Each task must include a clear action and 
  expected outcome
- Tasks must progress in difficulty and 
  responsibility from week 1 to week 4
- Address the employee by their first name 
  naturally in the introduction paragraph

Response Format:
Always return your response in this exact structure 
as plain text, no JSON, no markdown, no code blocks:

30-Day Onboarding Schedule for [Employee Name]
Role: [Role]
Department: [Department]
Start Date: [Start Date]
Reporting To: [Manager Name]

Welcome Message:
[One warm and personalized paragraph welcoming 
the employee and setting expectations for 
the next 30 days]
